issuesSummary.title: FR-007 says filters apply 'quickly'
issuesSummary.fix: State the latency budget in the Technical Contract and bind AC-018 to it.

proposedLessons.name: bind latency wording to a budget
proposedLessons.appliesWhen: the PRD contains a performance-sensitive user action
proposedLessons.issue: FR-007 used 'quickly' with no measurable budget anywhere in the PRD.
proposedLessons.writerRule: Never write a speed adjective without a numeric budget in the Technical Contract.
proposedLessons.reviewerCheck: For every speed adjective in an FR, verify a numeric budget exists and an AC asserts it.

proposedGlossaryTerms.definition: A filterable attribute of a catalog item, with a fixed set of selectable values.
proposedGlossaryTerms.reason: The PRD alternates between 'facet' and 'filter' for the same concept.
